**QA Frame Report**

**(1) Trunk lean ranking — PASS**
- Dash apex (img 2): ~35–40° forward — deepest lean ✔
- Sprint (img 3): ~20–25° ✔
- Run (img 1): ~10–15°, near-upright ✔
- Ranking dash > sprint > run holds.

**(2) Upper arm:forearm ratio — PASS**
Img 2 (best read, white skeleton): upper arm ≈30–34 px vs forearm ≈24–26 px → ~1.25–1.35x. Reads ≈1.3x as intended. Img 3 consistent; img 1 arms mostly occluded by sheath/blade, can't verify — re-capture with arm swung clear.

**(3) Elbow bends / reach — PASS with note**
- Dash (img 2): trailing arm elbow ~90–100°, lead arm ~60–70°; hands land near hip/shoulder reach envelope. Readable.
- Sprint (img 3): front arm elbow ~80°, hand extends believably past knee line. Readable.
- Run (img 1): arms folded into torso silhouette; elbows technically bent (~90°) but not readable — silhouette merge issue, not proportion issue.

**(4) Limb artifacts**
- Img 2: dash afterimage (ghost skeleton) is intentional but the two torsos overlap — trailing ghost's leg reads as a 3rd limb on the lead figure at a glance. Consider alpha < 40% or 1-frame offset.
- Img 3: foot contact — trailing leg's foot floats ~10–15 px above ground line at extension; rear foot clips the parry ring VFX slightly.
- Img 1: sword sheath pommel ring intersects rear hip; no skeletal break.
- No joint dislocations, no inverted knees/elbows, no limb-length pops across the three frames.

**Verdict:** Ship-ready on proportions and lean; fix ghost-limb readability (img 2) and sprint foot float (img 3) before final.
